infoYearT1.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/6] Families were included in the sample if they gave birth to a child after the 2012 survey due to the legal changes in paternity leave entitlement which occurred the same year. We also restricted the sample to couples who had a child within one year of the start of the study to allow the use of 3 time points. We pooled together subsamples of couples that had a child in 2012 and 2013.
